Daily (the portal stays open all day)

Every day a portal opens to the {wiki:Spirit Grounds}, a hunting area full of undead and nightmare creatures. The portal can appear near Darashia (Darama), in the Ghostlands or in Vengoth. There are no objectives or known achievements: it is simply a place to hunt, with creatures that change regardless of which portal is open.
No minimum level, but the creatures can be strong (they depend on the set active that day).
Only for the Vengoth portal: you must have started mission 4 (*The Dark Lands*) of the {wiki:Blood Brothers Quest|Blood Brothers Quest}, so that {npc:Harlow} takes you to Vengoth.
Hunting supplies (potions, runes) suited to that day's creatures
No reward of its own: it's a hunting area (experience and loot from the creatures)
On days when the Mini World Change is active, through the portal open that day (Darama, Ghostlands or Vengoth).
Premium only. The Vengoth portal requires access to {wiki:Vengoth} (mission 4 of the {wiki:Blood Brothers Quest|Blood Brothers Quest}).
Check the {wiki:World Board} (or the broadcast messages) to see which of the three portals is open today before you travel.
The creatures inside don't depend on which portal is open: it's like two mini world changes in one.
1. Finding out which portal is open
Read the message of the day
Only one of the three portals opens each day. Identify it from the World Board message or from the in-game announcement.

This portal is on the {wiki:Kha'zeel|Kha'Zeel} mountain, between **Darashia** and **Ankrahmun**, 2 floors above ground level ({coord:33161,32561,5}). Leave **Darashia** heading **southwest** through the desert to the mountain and climb up to the portal: the Spirit Grounds entrances have ramps that lead to the teleport and give off ghostly smoke, so they're easy to recognise.

The {wiki:Ghostlands} are **west** of **Carlin**. Leave Carlin to the west and go through the Ghostlands entrance cave ({coord:32222,31767,7}); then continue to the **northwest** coast, where the portal is ({coord:32176,31788,7}).
Map of the Ghostlands, west of Carlin
Even though the portal is in the Ghostlands, Free Accounts can't enter the Spirit Grounds.

Take a boat to **Yalahar**. At the docks of the **Trade Quarter** (straight **south** from the main gate), talk to {npc:Harlow}: {key:hi}, {key:vengoth}, {key:yes} (100 gp). He drops you off in the **west** of {wiki:Vengoth|Vengoth}; the portal is on the **south** coast ({coord:32909,31540,7}).
Go to the portal that is open that day and enter it to reach the {wiki:Spirit Grounds}.
Inside, hunt the creatures. You'll find **one** of these three sets (it changes independently of the portal):
Set 3 (Nightmares, Spectres, Phantasms) is much stronger than set 1. Check what's inside before pulling lots of monsters.

The wiki doesn't describe a special exit: go back to the area where the teleport dropped you (next to {npc:The Gate Keeper}) and leave the same way you came in. Keep some potions for the return. Then, depending on that day's portal, go back to the city like this:
Go down the Kha'Zeel mountain and walk back **northeast** to **Darashia** (or continue to **Ankrahmun**).
Go back **east** through the entrance cave ({coord:32222,31767,7}) to **Carlin**.
Go to {npc:Harlow} in the **west** of Vengoth ({coord:32857,31550,7}) and say {key:hi}, {key:yalahar}, {key:yes} (50 gp) to return to **Yalahar**.
No objectives or achievements associated with this Mini World Change are known.
